data.name: Aytan
data.long_meaning: Aytan refers to the night gazer, one who stays up late to observe the stars and seek guidance from the heavens. It is derived from the Arabic word 'a'tana', which means 'to look, observe, or watch'. In Islamic tradition, this behavior is encouraged as a way to connect with Allah and gain insight into the divine.
